context: Ren interviews a researcher on a long study.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: research interview; formal vocabulary (自体/とともに/以来/以降/いずれ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この研究は、いつ以来続いていますか?
lines.en: Since when has this research continued?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 十年以来、続けています。
lines.en: We've continued it for ten years.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: テーマ自体は、変わりましたか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: テーマ自体は、ほぼ変わりません。
lines.en: The theme itself has barely changed.
lines.style: patient researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 技術の進歩とともに、変わった点は?
lines.en: What changed along with tech progress?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近年以降、測定がとても正確になりました。
lines.en: From recent years on, measurement got very accurate.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いずれ、結論が出るんですか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いずれ、はっきりした答えを出したいですね。
lines.en: Eventually, I want to reach a clear answer.
lines.style: warm researcher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
